purpose: Provenance and rights records for acquired homepage photography. Bridge target: apps/ai-institute/public/photography/metadata/photo_manifest.json. Integration: PHOTO map, page.tsx photo props, and MissionChapter alt pass-through wired on 2026-09-24 after human authorization.

policy.authenticity: No generated people as Bhavya participants; no stock children as Bhavya students; no fabricated documentary scenes or impact statistics.
policy.naming: Honest basenames only. Books assets must not occupy knowledge-school-children.jpg. Landscape community assets must not occupy community-village-gathering.jpg.
policy.regression_guard: Never store non-JPEG bytes under .jpg (commit cea919c).

processing.method: crop-to-3:2-where-applicable, scale to target width, JPEG q82, optional WebP q82 derivative (not wired into app)
processing.pipeline_note: Repo has no sharp/imagemin AVIF pipeline; WebP derivatives exist on disk only as optional candidates for a later integration phase.
